chunks: 4536 - Durays al-Kunasi narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

A woman came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله for some need, and he said to her: “Perhaps you are one of those who delay.” She said: “Who are those who delay, O Messenger of Allah?” He said: “It is the woman whose husband calls her for some need, but she continues delaying him until her husband becomes drowsy and then sleeps. Such a woman continues to be cursed by the angels until her husband wakes up.”

key_terms.الْحَاجَةِ: a need, here referring contextually to a marital or intimate need
key_terms.الْمُسَوِّفَاتِ: women who keep delaying and putting off responding
key_terms.تُسَوِّفُهُ: she keeps postponing him or delaying him

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about delaying a husband's marital request?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against a wife deliberately delaying her husband when he calls her for an intimate marital need. It emphasizes the seriousness of neglecting spousal rights and presents prompt responsiveness within marriage as an important ethical duty.
